# 1. Load libraries and functions
```{R}
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, windfetch, raster, sf, terra, gdistance, glmmTMB, tmap, MuMIn, tidyterra, lme4, MASS, effects, AER, ggpubr, vegan, viridis, cowplot, biscale, RColorBrewer, caret, pROC, boot)
source("code/function script.r")
```
Here we create points along the coastline and islands to calculate gravity and exposure and then predict debris deposition across the coastline. We then use these predictions to assess the current prioritisation of clean ups, and identify high priority sites for future clean ups.
# 2. Model coastline
```{R}
e <- ext(148.00916, 149.34895, -21.34380, -19.90391)
coastline <- vect("data/coast_nobuff.shp") %>% crop(e) %>% project(exposure_data) %>% st_as_sf()

point_distance <- 500
create_regular_points <- function(line, distance) {
  line_length <- as.numeric(st_length(line))
  n_points <- floor(line_length / distance)
  points <- st_line_sample(line, sample = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_points + 1))
  points_sf <- st_sf(geometry = points)
  return(points_sf)
}
points_list <- lapply(st_geometry(coastline), create_regular_points, distance = point_distance)
all_points_sf <- do.call(rbind, points_list)
all_points_sf$id <- seq_len(nrow(all_points_sf))
st_crs(all_points_sf) <- st_crs(coastline)
st_cast(all_points_sf, "POINT") %>% mutate(Travel_type = "Ocean") %>%
st_write("outputs/regular_points_single.gpkg")
#Sites that were deemed to be inland or riverine were manually removed manually in ARCpro (comparing to satelite imaging).
```

# 3. Apply gravity to coastline
```{R}
e <- raster::extent(148.00916, 149.34895, -21.34380, -19.90391)
pop_raster  		<- rast("data/population_aus_northeast_2018-10-01.tif") %>%
                       crop(e) %>%
                       project("+proj=utm +zone=55 +south +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")#population density grid cells
site_points <- st_read("outputs/regular_points_single.gpkg") %>% st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster)) %>%
                mutate(id = row_number())
#Queensland roads layer had roads on islands removed as they would adjust island sites to be non-ocean travel
queensland_roads 	<- st_read("data/queensland_roads_adjusted.gpkg") %>%
                       st_crop(e) %>%
					   filter(CLASS != "Ferry") %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster)) %>%
					   st_as_sf()
bathy				<- rast("data/3_ausseabed_Great_Barrier_Reef_C_2020_30m_OV.tif") %>%
					   crop(e) %>%
					   project("+proj=utm +zone=55 +south +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
ports       		<- st_read("data/ports.gpkg") %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster)) %>%
					   st_crop(bathy) %>%
					   filter(FACILITY == "Boat Ramp") %>%
					   filter(!NAME %in% c("Peter Faust Dam via Proserpine",
					   					   "Murray Creek, Landing Road",
										   "Mount Jukes, Howell's Road (Constant Creek)",
										   "Pleystowe",
										   "Kinchant Dam, Kinchant Dam Road",
										   "Teemburra Dam, Lucas Paddock Road",
										   "Eungella Dam, Eungella Dam Road",
										   "Andergrove, Apsley Way",
										   "Mackay, River Street",
										   "Dunnrock, Dunrock Esplanade",
										   "Proserpine River, Conway Road")) %>%
					   dplyr::select(NAME) %>%
					   rename(Site = "NAME") %>%
					   rename(geometry = "Shape")
border_poly 		<- st_read("data/Australia_Polygon.shp") %>%
                       filter(name == "Queensland") %>%
					   st_crop(e) %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster))

ocean_presence <- bathy
ocean_presence[ocean_presence >= 3] <- NA
ocean_presence[ocean_presence < 3] <- 1
ocean_presence <- mask(ocean_presence, border_poly, inverse = TRUE, touches = TRUE)
# Move beach and port points to nearest ocean cell
beach_points_moved <- move_points_to_ocean(site_points, ocean_presence, sitedata = "id")
port_points_moved <- move_points_to_ocean(ports, ocean_presence, sitedata = "Site")
beach_points_moved <- beach_points_moved %>% rename(Site = "id")
beaches_linked <- find_nearest_port(beach_points_moved, port_points_moved)
beaches_linked <- beaches_linked %>% mutate(Site = row_number())

# Calculate the distance from each point to the nearest road to determine travel type
distances <- st_distance(beaches_linked, queensland_roads)
min_distances <- apply(distances, 1, min)
beaches_linked <- beaches_linked %>% 
  mutate(Travel_type = ifelse(min_distances < 300, "Land", "Ocean"))
#calculate ocean_travel
ocean <- mask(bathy, border_poly, inverse = TRUE, touches = TRUE) %>%
         crop(st_buffer(beaches_linked, 5000))
ocean_trans <- get_ocean_transition(ocean, 10)
beaches_linked$ocean_trav <- 0
for(i in 1:nrow(beaches_linked)){
  if(beaches_linked$Travel_type[i] == "Ocean"){
  beaches_linked[i, ]$ocean_trav <- get_ocean_travel(origin = beaches_linked[i, ],
				 destination = port_points_moved,
				 transition = ocean_trans,
				 output = "distance")
  }
message("processed ", i, " of ", nrow(beaches_linked))
}

#Assigning beaches which have no ocean travel to calculated land distance from itself not nearest port
beaches_noocean <- filter(beaches_linked, Travel_type == "Land")$Site
beaches_linked$nearest_port <- ifelse(beaches_linked$Site %in% beaches_noocean, beaches_linked$Site, beaches_linked$nearest_port)
st_write(beaches_linked, "data/beaches_linked_coastpoints.gpkg")
###Here we manually checked the points to remove any additional locations that needed to be removed.
beaches_linked <- st_read("data/beaches_linked_coastpoints.gpkg")
#1. Remove duplicated points (where the auto generation made two points for the same location).
beaches_linked$geometry_wkt <- st_as_text(beaches_linked$geom)
beaches_linked <- beaches_linked[!duplicated(beaches_linked$geometry_wkt), ]
beaches_linked <- dplyr::select(beaches_linked, !geometry_wkt)
#2. Remove points that are within river systems, or not coastal
beaches_linked <- beaches_linked %>% filter(!Site %in% c(1812, 1842, 2114, 2426:2430, 2685:2699))
st_write(beaches_linked, "data/beaches_linked_coastpoints_adjusted.gpkg")
#Adding sites with no ocean travel as ports to calculate land travel
beaches_noport <- filter(beaches_linked, Site %in% beaches_noocean) %>% rename(geometry = "geom") %>% dplyr::select(Site, geometry)
st_write(rbind(beaches_noport, port_points_moved), "data/port_points_moved_coastpoints.gpkg")

#Calculate land travel for each port
beaches_linked <- st_read("data/beaches_linked_coastpoints_adjusted.gpkg")
port_points_moved <- st_read("data/port_points_moved_coastpoints.gpkg")
ports_reduced <- port_points_moved %>%
				 filter(Site %in% beaches_linked$nearest_port) %>% vect()

rasters <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(ports_reduced)) {
  # Generate a raster using 'get_land_distance'
  r <- get_land_distance(population = pop_raster,
                         origin = ports_reduced[i, ],
                         structures = queensland_roads,
                         decay_factor = 0.0001,
                         land_mask = border_poly)
  # Add the raster to the list
  rasters[[i]] <- r
}
names(rasters) <- ports_reduced$Site
write_rds(rasters, "outputs/ldcp_templist.rds")
rasters <- read_RDS("C:/Users/traurigm/Desktop/ldcp_templist.rds")
stack <- terra::rast(rasters)
writeRaster(stack, "data/land_distance_stack_coastpoints.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

df <- data.frame(site_name = beaches_linked$Site, 
				 gravity = 0)
land_distances <- rast("data/land_distance_stack_coastpoints.tif")

#put it together
pop_reclass <- terra::classify(pop_raster, rcl = matrix(c(NA, NA, 0), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE), right = NA) %>%
    mask(border_poly, touches = TRUE)
for(i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  df$gravity[i] <- calculate_gravity(study_site = beaches_linked[i,],
                                     population = pop_raster,
					                 land_distances = land_distances,
					                 constant = 1)
}
write.csv(df, "outputs/gravity_coastpoints.csv")
beaches_linked$gravity <- df$gravity
st_write(beaches_linked, "outputs/beaches_coast_withgrav.gpkg")
```

# 4. Apply exposure to coastline
```{R}
#Apply exposure to coastline
bathy				<- rast("data/3_ausseabed_Great_Barrier_Reef_C_2020_30m_OV.tif") %>%
#					     crop(e) %>%
					     project("+proj=utm +zone=55 +south +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

site_points <- st_read("outputs/beaches_coast_withgrav.gpkg")
border_poly 		<- st_read("data/Australia_Polygon.shp") %>%
                       filter(name == "Queensland") %>%
#					   st_crop(e) %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(bathy))

#Removing points that were identified as being land rather than coastal (windfetch failed to capture fetch for these sites), manually checked in ARCpro using satellite imaging.
site_points <- site_points %>% filter(!Site %in% c(12, 213, 274, 300, 424, 431, 499, 587, 588, 597, 625, 669, 670, 682, 684, 732, 863, 893, 896, 905, 917, 918,
                                                         1007, 1021, 1031, 1039, 1041, 1043, 1102, 1112, 1116, 1312, 1313, 1436, 1458, 1500, 2015, 2060,
                                                         2108, 2185, 2293, 2349, 2484, 2518, 2520, 2719, 2727, 2740, 2746))
site_points <- site_points %>% filter(gravity < 53) # Max range of gravity from model was 52.1992
bathy[bathy <= 5] <- NA
bathy[bathy >= 5] <- 1
obstacles <- st_union(st_as_sf(as.polygons(bathy)), st_geometry(border_poly))
my_fetch <- windfetch(obstacles, site_points %>% dplyr::select("Site"), n_directions = 9, max_dist = 600)
fetch_sf <- as_sf(my_fetch)
sites <- data.frame(Sites = site_points$Site)
for(i in 1:length(sites$Sites)){
	sites$fetch_site[i] <- paste0("Site ", i)
}
#left join sites to my_fetch
fetch_sf <- left_join(fetch_sf, sites, by = c("site_name" = "fetch_site"))
#calculate the length of each linestring and add that length as a column
st_write(fetch_sf, "outputs/fetch_coastal_36_final.gpkg")
st_write(site_points, "outputs/gravity_coast_final.gpkg")
```

# 5. Calculate wind exposure for all coastal points and predict debris accumulation across coastline
```{R}
#Predict debris across coastline
#Start with predicting a sample of locations
beaches_linked <- st_read("outputs/gravity_coast_final.gpkg") # Max range of gravity from model was 52.1992
beaches_linked$Site <- as.character(beaches_linked$Site) 
beaches_exposed <- st_read("outputs/fetch_coastal_36_final.gpkg")
wind_data <- read.csv("data/wind/HM01X_Data_033255_999999999512646.txt") %>%
             filter(Wind.speed.in.km.h != 0) %>%
			 mutate(Wind.direction.in.degrees.true = ifelse(Wind.direction.in.degrees.true == 360, 0, Wind.direction.in.degrees.true))
wind_summarized <- wind_data %>%
				   group_by(Wind.direction.in.degrees.true) %>%
				   summarize(Wind.speed = mean(Wind.speed.in.km.h),
				             frequency = n()/length(wind_data$Wind.direction.in.degrees.true))
exposure_data <- left_join(beaches_exposed, wind_summarized, by = c("directions" = "Wind.direction.in.degrees.true")) %>% group_by(Sites, directions) %>%
				 summarize(line_exposure = ((fetch^0.3)*Wind.speed*frequency)) %>%
				 group_by(Sites) %>%
				 summarize(site_exposure = sum(line_exposure))

beaches_linked$exposure <- exposure_data$site_exposure
coastaldata <- beaches_linked %>% filter(exposure < 959 & exposure > 85) #Max range of exposure (after power transformation) was 958.55076 and min range was 85.71388
scaling_parameters <- readRDS("outputs/scaling_parameters.rds")
coastaldata$gravity <- scale(coastaldata$gravity, center = scaling_parameters$gravity_center, scale = scaling_parameters$gravity_scale)
coastaldata$exposure <- scale(coastaldata$exposure, center = scaling_parameters$site_exposure_center, scale = scaling_parameters$site_exposure_scale)

#Predict debris
complete_model <- readRDS("outputs/full_model.rds")
melted_model <- readRDS("outputs/melted_model.rds")

#Predict debris using the melted_model
predict_high <- coastaldata %>% dplyr::select(Site, gravity, exposure, -geom) %>% as.data.frame() %>%  
                mutate(floatiness = "High dispersal") %>%
                rename(site_exposure = exposure) %>%
                mutate(num_cleans = 1) %>%
                mutate(year = "2022")
predict_low <- coastaldata %>% dplyr::select(Site, gravity, exposure, -geom) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                mutate(floatiness = "Low dispersal") %>%
                rename(site_exposure = exposure) %>%
                mutate(num_cleans = 1) %>%
                mutate(year = "2022")

predictions_high <- predict(melted_model, newdata = predict_high, type = "response")
predictions_low <- predict(melted_model, newdata = predict_low, type = "response")
coastaldata$debris <- predictions_high + predictions_low
st_write(coastaldata, "outputs/coastal_with_predicted_debris.gpkg")
```
# 6. Assessment of ecobarg cleanups
Here we use the predicted debris values across the coastline to assess the current prioritisation of clean ups, and identify high priority sites for future clean ups. We do this in two ways, first by assigning each clean up to the nearest point on the coastline and using the predicted debris value for that point, and second by predicting debris values for the clean up sites themselves using their gravity and exposure values.
```{R}
coastaldata <- st_read("outputs/coastal_with_predicted_debris.gpkg")
gravity_data <- read.csv("outputs/gravity_final.csv") %>%
                filter(!site_name %in% c("Rattray, Grumbell, Grassy Islands", "Goat Island Beach, South Molle Island")) %>%
                dplyr::select(site_name, gravity)
exposure_data <- st_read("outputs/exposure_data_testing.gpkg") %>% dplyr::select(Sites, pw_3_exposure) %>% rename(site_exposure = pw_3_exposure) %>% st_drop_geometry()
clean_ups <- left_join(exposure_data, gravity_data, by = c("Sites" = "site_name")) %>% rename(Site = Sites)
scaling_parameters <- readRDS("outputs/scaling_parameters.rds")
clean_ups$gravity <- scale(clean_ups$gravity, center = scaling_parameters$gravity_center, scale = scaling_parameters$gravity_scale)
clean_ups$site_exposure <- scale(clean_ups$site_exposure, center = scaling_parameters$site_exposure_center, scale = scaling_parameters$site_exposure_scale)
predict_high <- clean_ups %>% dplyr::select(Site, gravity, site_exposure) %>% as.data.frame() %>%  
                mutate(floatiness = "High dispersal capacity") %>%
                mutate(num_cleans = 1) %>%
                mutate(year = "2022")
predict_low <- clean_ups %>% dplyr::select(Site, gravity, site_exposure) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
                mutate(floatiness = "Low dispersal capacity") %>%
                mutate(num_cleans = 1) %>%
                mutate(year = "2022")
melted_model <- readRDS("outputs/melted_model.rds")
predictions_high <- predict(melted_model, newdata = predict_high, type = "response")
predictions_low <- predict(melted_model, newdata = predict_low, type = "response")
clean_ups$debris <- predictions_high + predictions_low

site_data <- st_read("data/beaches_linked.gpkg") %>% dplyr::select(Site, geom) %>% filter(Site %in% clean_ups$Site)
site_data$debris <- clean_ups$debris
site_data$gravity <- clean_ups$gravity
site_data$site_exposure <- clean_ups$site_exposure
st_write(site_data, "outputs/clean_ups with predictions.gpkg")

# Step 1: Calculate Quartiles for gravity and debris
terciles_gravity <- quantile(coastaldata$gravity, probs = c(1/3, 2/3))
terciles_debris <- quantile(coastaldata$debris, probs = c(1/3, 2/3))

# Step 2: Categorize Variables
categorize <- function(value, terciles) {
  if (value <= terciles[1]) {
    return("Low")
  } else if (value <= terciles[2]) {
    return("Medium")
  } else {
    return("High")
  }
}

coastaldata <- coastaldata %>%
  mutate(
    gravity_category = sapply(gravity, categorize, terciles_gravity),
    debris_category = sapply(debris, categorize, terciles_debris)
  )

# Step 3: Combine Categories
coastaldata <- coastaldata %>%
  mutate(
    combined_category = paste(gravity_category, debris_category, sep = "_")
  )

# Step 4: Assess the currenty prioritisation of clean ups
#Scenario 1: Nearest point to clean up
nearest_indices <- st_nearest_feature(clean_ups, coastaldata)
clean_ups$combined_category <- coastaldata$combined_category[nearest_indices]
clean_ups$gravity_category <- coastaldata$gravity_category[nearest_indices]
clean_ups$debris_category <- coastaldata$debris_category[nearest_indices]
clean_ups$gravity <- coastaldata$gravity[nearest_indices]
clean_ups$debris <- coastaldata$debris[nearest_indices]
table(clean_ups$combined_category)
st_write(clean_ups, "outputs/clean_ups_assessment.gpkg")
#Scenario 2: Predicting amongst sites themselves
clean_ups <- st_read("outputs/clean_ups with predictions.gpkg")
clean_ups <- clean_ups %>%
  mutate(
    gravity_category = sapply(gravity, categorize, terciles_gravity),
    debris_category = sapply(debris, categorize, terciles_debris)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    combined_category = paste(gravity_category, debris_category, sep = "_")
  )
table(clean_ups$combined_category)
st_write(clean_ups, "outputs/clean_ups_assessment2.gpkg")


coastaldata %>% filter(combined_category %in% c("High_High", "High_Medium", "Medium_High")) %>%
st_write("outputs/high_priority_sites.gpkg")
library(mapview)
mapview(temp, zcol = "combined_category") + mapview(clean_ups, color = "blue")
```
# 7. Validate gravity through external dataset
```{R}
beaches <- st_read("outputs/beaches_species_notscaled.gpkg")
beaches <- rename(beaches, "Gravity" = gravity)
beaches <- rename(beaches, "Exposure" = exposure)
beaches <- st_buffer(beaches, 200)
#Using visitation raster, here we have less overlap in beaches, but a higher level of correlation where they do overlap 
visit_r <- rast("data/tourism_rast.tif")
rcl <- matrix(c(2147483647, NA), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
visit_r <- classify(visit_r, rcl)
for(i in 1:nrow(beaches)){
  beach <- beaches[i,]
  beaches$reef_vis[i] <- mean(terra::extract(visit_r, beach)$tourism_rast, na.rm = TRUE)
}
beach_cor <- filter(beaches, !is.na(reef_vis))
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Gravity, method = "pearson")


visit_r <- rast("data/tourism_value.tif") %>% crop(beaches) #visitation value
rcl <- matrix(c(65535, NA), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
visit_r <- classify(visit_r, rcl)
for(i in 1:nrow(beaches)){
  beach <- beaches[i,]
  beaches$reef_vis[i] <- mean(terra::extract(visit_r, beach)$tourism_value, na.rm = TRUE)
}
beach_cor <- filter(beaches, !is.na(reef_vis))
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Gravity, method = "pearson")
```
